items.text: Sail wind behavior is now fully server‑side, eliminating client/server mismatches and ensuring consistent wind effects on sailboats.

2026-10-02.summary:

### Livestock & Animals

items.text: Fixed continuous input failures caused by mis‑detected Steam input at startup.
Fixed gamepad cursor state handling.
Sleeping bag placement range guide now updates correctly when its configuration values change.
Pie menu now correctly updates option names and descriptions, removing stale placeholder text.

Improved livestock behavior: reduced clipping when leading multiple animals or at troughs, prevented attacks on players inside vehicles, fixed collisions with travelling vendors, resolved various bull and ram issues (head‑butting, charging glitches, animation errors), and stopped cows from sliding unexpectedly. Livestock also can no longer be damaged inside safe zones.
Jungle plants now receive proper groundwater, fixing the previous lack of water for terrain‑placed flora.
Fixed rifle orientation while sprinting and added sprint speed modifiers to specific rifles (med, jungle, diver AKs).
Minicrossbow now plays only the necessary reload animation during partial reloads in 3‑person mode.
Fixed a potential crash caused by a NullReferenceException in lock loading logic.
Corrected biofuel generator placement so it no longer snaps backwards when placed.
Added the electronic chessboard DLC, including split game model, chess and checkers pieces, and updated deployable prefab.
Water jugs are now classified as Items, restoring the ability to recycle them and allowing storage in fridges and minifridges.
The quick join menu now correctly refreshes, ensuring players see up‑to‑date server listings.

2026-10-01.summary:
### Input & UI
- Fixed continuous input failures caused by mis‑detected Steam input at startup.
- Fixed gamepad cursor state handling.
- Sleeping bag placement range guide now updates correctly when its configuration values change.
- Pie menu now correctly updates option names and descriptions, removing stale placeholder text.

### Livestock & Animals
- Improved livestock behavior: reduced clipping when leading multiple animals or at troughs, prevented attacks on players inside vehicles, fixed collisions with travelling vendors, resolved various bull and ram issues (head‑butting, charging glitches, animation errors), and stopped cows from sliding unexpectedly. Livestock also can no longer be damaged inside safe zones.
- Jungle plants now receive proper groundwater, fixing the previous lack of water for terrain‑placed flora.

### Combat & Weapons
- Fixed rifle orientation while sprinting and added sprint speed modifiers to specific rifles (med, jungle, diver AKs).
- Minicrossbow now plays only the necessary reload animation during partial reloads in 3‑person mode.

### Structures & Interaction
- Fixed a potential crash caused by a NullReferenceException in lock loading logic.
- Corrected biofuel generator placement so it no longer snaps backwards when placed.

### DLC Content
- Added the electronic chessboard DLC, including split game model, chess and checkers pieces, and updated deployable prefab.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Water jugs are now classified as Items, restoring the ability to recycle them and allowing storage in fridges and minifridges.

### Quality of Life
- The quick join menu now correctly refreshes, ensuring players see up‑to‑date server listings.

items.text: Boost foods now last 6 or 10 minutes and animals will prioritize troughs containing them.
Purchased animals spawn in front of the vendor rather than behind you.
Livestock now need less food to stay alive.
Wild livestock can no longer die from hunger; their health will not drop below 50%.
Livestock vendor now tells you how much wool you need when you don’t have enough.
Calf purchase dialogue correctly checks your scrap before confirming a purchase.
Crabs and jellyfish no longer disappear due to pooling bugs.
Wool vendor stack limits are now 25‑400; delivering a full stack of 400 wool grants the top reward tier.
New map cursor with fixed center crosshairs lets you add or remove markers directly at the cursor.
Map loading is now stable: scene switches no longer destroy the player, and reloads correctly reset the loading state so the camera works after `reloadmap`.
Player teams, invites, and contacts are retained after server crashes, and you can now opt out of entity save‑cache usage.
Milky Healing Tea now heals 112 health instead of being capped at 100.
Train car loot now respects the softcore multiplier and contains double the usual amount.
Boombox activation counts toward each teammate’s underwater lab objective when they’re in the same lab.
A countdown timer now appears on the dome pump while the oil rig countdown is active, and hole‑depth values are correctly cleared during hole passes.
Doors now count as closed for base occlusion, restoring interior privacy and defense visibility.
Adult livestock now receive two leads like horses, with rope ends hidden off‑camera, improving animal leading and visual clarity.
Entity scaling updates instantly for affected objects without needing to leave network range, fixing delayed size changes.

2026-09-30.summary:
### Animals & Wildlife
- Boost foods now last 6 or 10 minutes and animals will prioritize troughs containing them.
- Purchased animals spawn in front of the vendor rather than behind you.
- Livestock now need less food to stay alive.
- Wild livestock can no longer die from hunger; their health will not drop below 50%.
- Livestock vendor now tells you how much wool you need when you don’t have enough.
- Calf purchase dialogue correctly checks your scrap before confirming a purchase.
- Crabs and jellyfish no longer disappear due to pooling bugs.

### Economy & Vendors
- Wool vendor stack limits are now 25‑400; delivering a full stack of 400 wool grants the top reward tier.

### Map & Navigation
- New map cursor with fixed center crosshairs lets you add or remove markers directly at the cursor.
- Map loading is now stable: scene switches no longer destroy the player, and reloads correctly reset the loading state so the camera works after `reloadmap`.

### Multiplayer & Persistence
- Player teams, invites, and contacts are retained after server crashes, and you can now opt out of entity save‑cache usage.

### Gameplay Tweaks
- Milky Healing Tea now heals 112 health instead of being capped at 100.
- Train car loot now respects the softcore multiplier and contains double the usual amount.
- Boombox activation counts toward each teammate’s underwater lab objective when they’re in the same lab.
- A countdown timer now appears on the dome pump while the oil rig countdown is active, and hole‑depth values are correctly cleared during hole passes.

### Base Mechanics
- Doors now count as closed for base occlusion, restoring interior privacy and defense visibility.

### Animal Handling
- Adult livestock now receive two leads like horses, with rope ends hidden off‑camera, improving animal leading and visual clarity.

### Building & Scaling
- Entity scaling updates instantly for affected objects without needing to leave network range, fixing delayed size changes.
